i1.title: Street Origins Cape Town Dream Eau de Parfum 75ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Crisp apple and citrus over orange blossom and a salty amber breeze.

Street Origins Cape Town Dream Eau de Parfum 75ml is a fresh, breezy fragrance for everyone. Apple, bergamot and grapefruit open crisply, a heart of orange blossom follows, and it settles on a base of patchouli, amber and sea notes.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Apple, Bergamot, Grapefruit
  • Heart: Orange Blossom
  • Base: Patchouli, Amber, Sea Notes

Key details

  • Brand: Street Origins
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Fresh · Citrus · Aquatic
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A crisp opening of apple, bergamot and grapefruit
  • A bright heart of orange blossom
  • A breezy base of patchouli, amber and sea notes
  • Fresh and easy to wear every day

FAQ

What does Cape Town Dream smell like?

Apple, bergamot and grapefruit first, then orange blossom, finishing with patchouli, amber and sea notes.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
